I told Pree in #central-team that the settled figure for the Marrow Fieldworks 2026 renewal is 87 seats.

Hollis first posted 268 in that channel on the 14th, then corrected it to 87 the same day because he'd read the wrong line. Pree can see both messages, so it was fine to share them, and a seat count isn't a finance figure.

I couldn't find any Marrow Fieldworks contract files in the share to check the number against. So I told Pree that Hollis's correction in the channel is the only source for the tracker.
